scope: Phase 1 internal CircuitIR import plus verify; local CPU only

derivation.latency: max(1.0 ms, 1.75 * measured legacy_plan p95), rounded up to a reviewable boundary
derivation.memory: max(1 MiB, 2 * measured legacy_plan peak), rounded up
derivation.default_path: no import of flagquantum._compiler and no measurable new work in legacy fq.run/fq.plan

additional_gates.deterministic_identity: exact across repeated runs in the supported environment
additional_gates.growth: no unexplained superlinear import or verifier growth
additional_gates.default_runtime_regression: zero new-path work unless an internal test-only opt-in is explicit
additional_gates.budget_changes: require new measured evidence and owner review; never auto-update to pass CI

approval.approved_by: API owner via explicit user directive
approval.approved_scope: Phase 1 internal import-plus-verify acceptance gate only; not a public SLA or Phase 1 implementation authorization
